description: This Java source file defines the AddHeaderMessageMapper class, which implements the MessageMapper interface to add specific headers to messages during mapping operations, delegating to an internal DittoMessageMapper.

classes.name: AddHeaderMessageMapper
classes.description: Implementation of MessageMapper that adds headers for inbound and outbound messages, delegating core mapping to DittoMessageMapper.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the mapper, which is 'header'.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns an empty list indicating no content types are blocked.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configuration method which currently ignores provided config.

methods.name: map(ExternalMessage)
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage object, adds inbound header to the resulting adaptable objects.

methods.name: map(Adaptable)
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable object, adds outbound header to the resulting ExternalMessages.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns empty map, indicating no specific incoming conditions.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns empty map, indicating no specific outgoing conditions.
